about_the_game:
Rocrasher（大石头杀人事件）

PUSH and SMASH!!! Savor the ultimate thrill of crushing everything in your way!

Crushing the little figures along the road will increase the boulder's size and weight, granting it greater acceleration and diving force!

Multiple Levels to Choose From

Each stage offers a unique style — from the surface to the underground, roll your way through and crush everything in your path.

Satisfying Physics and Collision Feedback

Experience dynamic physics-based destruction. The way objects shatter depends on what you hit and how fast you crash into it, giving each impact a different level of feedback.

Various Interactive Mechanics

Want to clear the road for your giant boulder? Try out different abilities at your disposal:

1 Tap the boulder to push it in any direction.

2 Tap obstacles to smash them apart.

3 Crush as many little critters as you can.

Charming Cartoon Art Style & Immersive Audio-Visuals

A cute and quirky giant boulder, swaying grass and flowers, bouncing roaches — all enhanced by post-processing filters, outlines, sound effects, and screen shake. Together they create an engaging and stress-relieving audiovisual experience.
